when.doc: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled or in the party/raid. For compound tokens (eg. 'boss1target'), results are secret if any unit in the chain fails this.
when.name: SecretWhenUnitIdentityRestricted

when.doc: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.
when.name: SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted
